paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.16% on average, with DAX strongest (+2.63%) and Hang Seng weakest (-2.36%). Brent crude changed -2.34% to 110.52. Gold changed -0.64% to 4,034.6001. Bitcoin changed +0.23% to 80,978.1719. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.007%, a relative move of +1.09%. Among the firms tracked, Evercore (+17.22%) and Deutsche Bank (+10.71%) moved the most.
